svg.title: Amelia Earhart: 1937 world flight waypoint map
svg.desc: Real coastlines with selected 1937 flight stops from Oakland to Lae and the final Pacific leg toward Howland Island.
svg.metadata: Natural Earth v5.1.2, 1:50 million, public domain. Generated by scripts/build-geography.mjs. Boundaries follow the dataset's de facto policy and are not an endorsement of sovereignty claims.
svg.text: Amelia Earhart · 1937 equatorial flight & Pacific leg
Solid orange: completed stops (Oakland → Lae) · dashed cyan: final leg to Howland Island
Natural Earth 50m · equirectangular · approximate stop connections, not exact flight tracks
